learn_source: Watch the postman rescue a rain-soaked satchel under the eaves in the Town scene — the rounds run in all weather and the letters have to survive it
confirm_action: Cast it yourself on a wet thing once
mana_effect: Quality only: at high mana the thing dries flat and unwarped; at baseline it dries stiff and a little curled. Never whether the cast is possible.

receivers.physical_outcome: State-dependent: caught early, it dries flat with the ink intact; if the ink has already run, it dries smeared — dry fixes wet, not ruin
Dries through — it will now take an ignite
no_effect — there is no water to take out
No physical effect — living receivers never catch; the fur stays wet
receivers.reaction_kind: full-body shake, affronted stare at the caster

receivers.physical_outcome: No physical effect — his soaked coat stays soaked
receivers.reaction_kind: easy laugh, wrings the sleeve out by hand
